rows.grounds: optative verb expressing prescribed ritual action
compound indicating transmission path; -taḥ marks source or manner

items.question: What authoritative tradition governs the proper construction of the ritual diagram?
premises: The practitioner has completed the prescribed visualization of Tripurabhairavī.
A ritual diagram is to be constructed as the next act.
The construction must follow the path transmitted by the guru.
items.inference: Therefore the ritual diagram must be constructed according to the guru's tradition.
uncertainties: Whether maṇḍalaṃ refers to a specific diagram such as the śrīcakra or a general ritual diagram is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should then construct the diagram according to the tradition of the guru.
